headline: I've prayed about money for years. What's still blocking it?
note: generated from REVIEW-new-voice.md — not a wired draft

a: You turned the Magician. You had nothing to go on, and your hand found the worker of the three.
Look at his hands. Both are busy, and neither one is still.
You asked what's still blocking money you've prayed about. What catches me is that both those hands are busy.
And yet it hasn't landed. And you're still the one asking what's holding it.
Something stands between you and it, close by. I don't think any of it began with you.
Let me look closer at what's holding it…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. Nothing showed which was which, and you took the one held by one rope.
Look at the rope. It's tied at one ankle, and that's the whole of it.
You asked what's still blocking money you've prayed about. What holds my eye is that single rope and where it runs.
Still, it hasn't come through. And the question you brought me is what's holding it.
It doesn't take much to hold this in place. I don't think it began with you.
Let me look closer at what's holding it…
c: You turned the Fool. Face down, all three, and you chose the one already stepping.
Look at his feet. One is off the ground, the other still down.
You asked what's still blocking money you've prayed about. This card brings me to a foot already off the ground.
But it hasn't landed. And you're the one still waiting on it.
Something turns up at the point where it would land. I don't think this began with you.
Let me look closer at what's doing the holding…
